csv_scope_of_work: The State of Minnesota , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a consultant to perform a multimodal transportation planning study of MN 95 from I-94 to US 61 in southern Washington County. MnDOT will lead the study in partnership with Washington County. Tasks will include documenting existing and future conditions, identifying transportation user needs, developing and evaluating concepts to meet those needs, and producing a plan to implement improvements when funding becomes available. Some of the existing issues pertain to safety, pending development, livability, freight activity, and bicycle/pedestrian facilities. Public engagement will be performed to support these tasks.
